ModMetaData.name: rimUIMCP
ModMetaData.author: JerryLunar (Hcrab); based on RimBridgeServer by Andreas Pardeike
ModMetaData.description:
Turn a running RimWorld session into a live automation bridge.
rimUIMCP is a community-created bridge for external tools, test harnesses, and AI agents. It exposes broad live state and drives the real RimWorld UI instead of reimplementing gameplay outside the game.
Based on RimBridgeServer 2.1.1 by Andreas Pardeike and distributed under the MIT License with the original attribution retained.
IN PRACTICE YOU CAN
- inspect live game, map, camera, selection, notification, and UI state - drive debug actions, main tabs, Architect designators, saves, and screenshots - change mod settings and mod load order - run JSON or lowered Lua automation scripts - drive Dubs Performance Analyzer profiling when DPA is installed and active - let third-party mods expose async companion tools through RimUIMCP.Sdk and BridgeTools folders
RECOMMENDED SETUP
Use GABS to start RimWorld, discover the live bridge surface, and connect your automation client without manually managing ports or tokens.
DIRECT MODE
Standalone direct mode still works. Start RimWorld normally, read the bridge startup lines from the RimWorld log, and connect your client directly to the advertised port and token.
INSTALLATION
1. Download the latest release from GitHub 2. Unzip the rimUIMCP folder into RimWorld's Mods directory 3. Enable rimUIMCP in RimWorld 4. Prefer GABS when you want AI or harness-driven control
FEEDBACK
GitHub releases, issues, and docs: https://github.com/Hcrab/rimUIMCP
GABS: https://github.com/pardeike/GABS
